title: Cinematic Projection
description: A woman in a flowing white gown stands in a ruined, flower-strewn landscape holding a film projector that casts a beam of light. The beam illuminates a glowing white neon outline of a masked bunny-eared figure and a large red, white, and black circular target emblem containing an intricate symbol.
prompt: A woman in an elegant layered white gown stands in a dark ruined landscape overgrown with white flowers, operating a vintage film projector on a pedestal. The projector casts a bright beam containing a glowing neon white outline of a stylized masked bunny girl figure and a large circular red, white and black emblem with an intricate central symbol. A giant blood-red moon hangs in the black sky above crumbling gothic architecture, dramatic cinematic lighting, surreal atmosphere.
